date:ahasuerus-feasts-and-vashti-is-depo.note: Text says only the third year of his reign. The BC year depends on dating Ahasuerus outside Scripture.

date:ahasuerus-honors-mordecai@2d0992.note: Text gives no year, only that the king could not sleep that night. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:esther-is-made-queen@a76a63.note: Text gives the seventh year of his reign, tenth month. Dating Ahasuerus as Darius I gives 515 BC; as Xerxes I, 479 BC; outside Scripture.

date:haman-is-hanged@2d0992.note: Text gives no year, only that it happens at the second day of the banquet. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:haman-plots-to-destroy-the-jews@2d0.note: Text gives the twelfth year of his reign, first month. The BC year depends on dating Ahasuerus outside Scripture.

date:the-jews-defeat-their-enemies@cdf21.note: Text gives the thirteenth of Adar in the twelfth year. The BC year depends on dating Ahasuerus outside Scripture.

occurred-at:ahasuerus-feasts-and-vashti-.note: The text puts the king's throne and this feast at Shushan the palace. Shushan is identified with Susa from outside the text.

occurred-at:ahasuerus-honors-mordecai>su.note: The scene is the king's house and outward court, where the king sat in Shushan. Shushan is identified with Susa from outside the text.

occurred-at:esther-is-made-queen>susa_11.note: The text puts the women's house and the king's house at Shushan the palace. Shushan is identified with Susa from outside the text.

occurred-at:haman-is-hanged>susa_1118@a6.note: The banquet and palace garden are the palace, named as Shushan in 3.15. Shushan is identified with Susa from outside the text.

occurred-at:haman-plots-to-destroy-the-j.note: The decree is given in Shushan the palace, where the king and Haman sit down. Shushan is identified with Susa from outside the text.

occurred-at:reign-of-darius-ahasuerus>su.note: The text puts the king's throne at Shushan (1.2), but his reign covered 127 provinces (1.1). Shushan is identified with Susa, and Darius with Ahasuerus, from outside the text.

occurred-at:the-jews-defeat-their-enemie.note: The Jews struck in all the provinces, not only Shushan, where 800 died (9.6, 9.15).

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>ahasuerus-.note: He makes the feast (1.3) and approves the decree (1.21). The matched verse 1.1 only names his reign.
He commands the chronicles read (6.1) and orders the honour for Mordecai (6.10). The matched verse 6.2 does not show him acting.

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>esther-is-.note: He approves the maiden to be queen (2.4) and sets the crown on Esther's head (2.17). The matched verse 2.1 concerns Vashti.

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>haman-is-h.note: He orders Haman hanged on the gallows (7.9). The matched verse 7.5 is only his question about the offender.

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>haman-plot.note: He gives Haman his ring and the people to deal with as he sees fit (3.10-11). The matched verse 3.1 is Haman's promotion.

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>reign-of-d.note: The text says Ahasuerus reigned over 127 provinces. Equating him with Darius is an identification from outside Scripture.

participated-in:ahasuerus_117>the-jews-d.note: He grants the Jews the right to defend themselves (8.11) and commands the second day (9.14). The matched verse 8.7 only mentions Haman's house given to Esther.

participated-in:esther_1343>esther-is-ma.note: She is taken to the king's house and made queen (2.16-17). The matched verse 2.7 only tells of her upbringing.

participated-in:esther_1343>haman-is-han.note: She asks for her life and names Haman as the adversary (7.3, 7.6). The matched verse 7.1 only shows the banquet.

participated-in:haman_1360>ahasuerus-hon.note: Haman proposes the honour and arrays Mordecai in the royal apparel (6.6, 6.11). The matched verse 6.4 only has him entering the court.

participated-in:haman_1360>haman-is-hang.note: Haman is hanged on the gallows he had prepared. The matched verse 7.1 only shows him at the banquet.

participated-in:haman_1360>haman-plots-t.note: He seeks to destroy all the Jews (3.6) and asks the king to have them destroyed (3.9). The matched verse 3.1 is his promotion.

participated-in:hegai_1477>esther-is-mad.note: Hegai gives Esther her preparations and preferment (2.9), and she asks only what he appoints (2.15). The matched verse 2.3 spells him Hege and only names him keeper.

participated-in:memucan_1995>ahasuerus-f.note: Memucan speaks against Vashti before the king (1.16), and the king follows his word (1.21). The matched verse 1.14 is only a list of princes.

participated-in:mordecai_2107>ahasuerus-.note: The king asks what honour Mordecai received (6.3), and Haman leads him through the city (6.11). The matched verse 6.2 is about his earlier report.

participated-in:mordecai_2107>esther-is-.note: Mordecai raised Esther and watched over her (2.7, 2.11), but no verse has him take part in her choosing as queen.

participated-in:mordecai_2107>haman-is-h.note: Within the event (7:1–8:2), Mordecai comes before the king and receives Haman's ring and house (8:1-2). He has no part in the hanging itself.

participated-in:mordecai_2107>the-jews-d.note: The decree is written as Mordecai commanded (8.9), and the fear of him helps the Jews (9.3). The matched verse 8.7 names him only as one addressed.
